summary: Full backend + frontend testing for Sunjaya Asia Group. All 16 pytest backend tests pass (health, contact POST/GET with admin auth, admin verify, News CRUD, language filter, published filter). All frontend flows verified via Playwright: home page kinetic hero, EN/ID language toggle, navigation to all 7 pages, contact form submit + DB persistence, Admin CMS login/create/edit/delete/logout, News page renders CMS-created article, Global Presence click-to-preview interaction.
critical_code_review_comments: No public DELETE endpoint for /api/contact — test/spam contacts accumulate in DB. Consider adding admin DELETE /api/contact/{id} for cleanup.

Admin.jsx keeps token in localStorage and axios instance is recreated each render — this is fine for the current scope but the initial verify effect only triggers on token change; if user reloads with a stale/expired token, they'll be silently logged out. Acceptable for MVP.
server.py uses @app.on_event('shutdown') which is deprecated in newer FastAPI — should migrate to lifespan handler eventually. Not blocking.
CORS_ORIGINS defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True — this combination is not allowed by browsers per spec. In practice fine because credentials aren't sent, but tighten origins for production.
Contact endpoint has no rate limit or captcha — vulnerable to spam. Out of MVP scope but flag for production.
test_credentials: Admin token: sunjaya-admin-2026-secret (header X-Admin-Token). Loaded from /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
seed_data_creation: Two TEST_ contacts remain in DB after test runs (no cleanup endpoint exists). Backend tests self-cleanup all created news articles.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 16 pytest tests in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py are green. Test file is idempotent and cleans up its own news data. Contact records aren't deletable via API and accumulate — filter by TEST_ prefix if needed. Frontend uses framer-motion LineReveal that renders each word in its own span, so H1 inner_text returns text with newlines/no spaces between words (e.g. 'Thepower\nofinnovations.'); normalize with lowercase substring checks. Admin CMS uses window.confirm for delete — register a page.on('dialog') accept handler when automating deletes.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. All features listed in the review request work as expected.
